newsitem.title: FRANCE: L'Oreal sees higher sales, profits in 97.
newsitem.headline: L'Oreal sees higher sales, profits in 97.

text.p: L'Oreal chairman Lindsay Owen-Jones said on Wednesday he expected higher sales and profit for 1997.
"First quarter sales allow us to forecast a substantial rise in sales and profit for this year," he told a news conference.

"If rates hold steady from here to the end of the year, it would seem possible to forecast double-digit profit growth, which is our goal today," he said, without stating specifically whether he meant interest rates.
In February, L'Oreal reported a 1996 net attributable profit of 3.73 billion francs before capital gains and losses, up 10.3 percent on the preceding year.
